summary: The character has weight w_i at each infinite place; its value at diag(1,…,N) has ιₚ-norm a product of |N|_N^{±w_i(τ)} ≤ N^{w_i(τ)} ≤ N^{2b} over the f places.

steps.claim: Reduce to the largest S (the norm is monotone in S, `norm_detCharAt_diagN_anti`) and view diagN as a global finite point.

The lift character has weight w_i: |ιₚ(χ(g))| = ∏_τ |adeleExtension_τ(det g)|^{(weight exponent at τ)}; the determinant of an element supported at P is computed at the conjugate places; write the result as a product over τ.
steps.lean:
erw [D.hasWeight_liftChar.norm_padic_eq_prod ιₚ _ (unitary _).one_mem.2,
    ← G.det_of_supportedOn (s := 1) disjoint_star
    (embedGL_mem_supportedOn _), mul_right_comm, rpow_mul_natCast (by simp), ← Finset.prod_const]

steps.claim: At τ the determinant is the image of N or 1 (through conjugation and the inverse transpose).
steps.lean:
erw [G.det_snd, ← star_star (det _), adeleExtension_star, ← det_conjTranspose,
    ← U.inv_val_eq_conjTranspose, RingHom.map_det, congr($(adeleExtension_map_diagN ..)⁻¹.1.det)]

steps.claim: In both cases the factor is ≤ N^{2b}: |N|_N = 1/N and w_i(τ) ≤ 2b (`w_le_two_mul_b`, i ≤ 2m).
steps.lean: split <;> grw [← D.w_le_two_mul_b hi τ] <;> simp [norm_p_eq_inv, NeZero.one_le, one_le_pow₀]
